statement:
The sharing record gives “anyone with the link” for folder F-8.
Folder F-8 remains restricted to the coral group only because the press embargo has not yet lifted.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer states the recorded "anyone with the link" setting cannot be applied because "the press embargo has not yet lifted," asserting the record's value conflicts with the stated restriction.
